subject: Activation playbook & owner commitments — Acme trial
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation playbook & owner commitments — Acme trial

Hi Emma —

Great to meet you and Rajiv on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the trial kickoff: 

Summary of ask and scope
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference in Acme’s staging environment for 8 weeks; primary evaluation is latency and end-to-end cost per inference for customer-facing search assistant.
- Workloads: short-form queries (avg 32 tokens), batched bulk embedding runs for nightly index refresh, and a streaming chat flow for internal ops.

Proposed success criteria (we'll formalize this in the doc attached)
- P95 generation latency < 350ms for 32-token queries in Acme staging (90% of requests routed to dedicated pool)
- Average per-token cost <= target we discussed ($0.0009/token equivalent)
- Embedding throughput: 100k embeddings per night within 3 hours
- No model-inference security incidents; audit logs enabled and retained for 90 days

Owners (initial call notes)
- Infra / Staging network: Rajiv Patel (Acme) — infra changes, VPC peer/connectivity
- App integration: Emma Stone (Acme) — SDK/integration with search pipeline
- Security & compliance: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — audit logs, KMS interface, documentation
- Procurement / contract: procurement@acme-corp.com (Acme) and Laura Bennett (Redwood) — SOW and billing

Attachments: I'm attaching a short activation playbook and a draft SOW to accelerate procurement. Please review the owner columns and the timeline.

Next steps (proposed)
1) You confirm owners and add any missing stakeholders — by EOD Friday 6/13
2) We schedule a 30–45m technical kickoff (network pinning + API keys + test data) — propose Tue 6/17 or Wed 6/18
3) Laura to coordinate SOW/redlines with procurement; we’ll have a DocuSign-ready SOW within 3 business days after owner confirmation

Attachments: Acme_trial_activation_playbook.xlsx; SOW_draft_Acme.pdf

Thanks — looping Laura/Neha for visibility.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme-corp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation playbook & owner commitments — Acme trial

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Owners: confirmed — Rajiv will own infra and network peering; I will own app integration and steering the eval criteria with our PMs; procurement will handle SOW and billing (procurement@acme-corp.com).
- Success criteria: the latency and cost targets look good as a starting point; our PMs will add an availability tolerance (less than 0.5% failed requests during peak).
- Timeline: 6/17 at 10:00am PT works for a kickoff.

I’ve looped Rajiv and procurement. Rajiv — can you confirm there are no policy blockers on our side for VPC peering with Redwood and that we can open the required ports to the staging subnet?

Emma
Director, Search Platform
Acme Corp

Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick confirmation. I made a few updates to the attached activation playbook to reflect:
- A lightweight RACI matrix (Owner / Responsible / Consulted / Informed) for each milestone
- A suggested 8-week sprint plan with acceptance gates at weeks 2, 4, and 8
- Network checklist for Rajiv and a short SDK integration checklist for Emma’s team

Inline excerpt from the RACI table (please confirm):
- Network peering & firewall rules: Owner = Rajiv Patel (Acme) | Responsible = Acme infra team | Consulted = Neha Kapoor | Informed = Laura Bennett
- Client SDK integration & test harness: Owner = Emma Stone (Acme) | Responsible = Acme Search Eng team | Consulted = Karthik Iyer | Informed = Neha Kapoor
- Security review & audit log enablement: Owner = Neha Kapoor (Redwood) | Responsible = Redwood Security | Consulted = Rajiv Patel | Informed = Emma Stone
- Procurement sign-off & SOW: Owner = procurement@acme-corp.com | Responsible = Acme Procurement | Consulted = Laura Bennett | Informed = Karthik Iyer

Action items I need from Acme by EOD Friday 6/13:
- Rajiv: confirm network constraints and whether we need an on-prem agent instead of VPC peer (if policy blocks peering)
- Emma: confirm PM availability for weekly check-ins and that the PM will own acceptance test results
- Procurement: confirm billing contact and PO process (cc procurement email on reply)

I attached the updated playbook (Acme_trial_activation_playbook.xlsx) and a short success criteria doc (Acme_success_criteria.md). I’ll also drop the playbook into the shared drive once confirmed.

Best,
Karthik

Karthik —

All set from our side:
- Rajiv confirmed via separate note that VPC peering is fine; no on-prem agent needed. He asked for the exact CIDR ranges and a write-up of the minimal ingress rules which we should be able to implement by next week.
- PMs confirmed weekly check-ins (Thursdays 10am PT) and will own acceptance tests; they asked that Redwood supply a short test harness example and a Postman collection for smoke testing.
- Procurement confirmed billing path; they asked for SOW redlines and a DocuSign link.

Procurement note: procurement@acme-corp.com will expect a SOW that lists the 8-week timeline and the billing schedule. Please send Laura the editable SOW and we’ll route it for signatures.

We’re attaching the purchase request template from procurement and a short note with the PO process. Also confirming acceptance of the success criteria in Acme_success_criteria.md — Rajiv added the availability tolerance mention.

Attachments: procurement_po_template.docx; acme_po_instructions.pdf

Looking forward to the kickoff on 6/17 at 10:00am PT.

—
Emma
